margin_interpretation.strongest_new_positive: ASE ATM actually earned20% operating margin inQ3. A differentiated Intel packaging business at25% is economically possible, though not independently calibrated.
margin_interpretation.scope_warning: Amkor11.3% andASE20% are not identical services or revenue denominators. Material shares differ:50.7% vs27%. Intel includes owned materials but excludes customer-consigned logic/HBM. Its share is unreported.
margin_interpretation.ratio_boundary: Diagnostic ratios, not restated accounting margins, direct comparables or proof of Intel price premium.
margin_interpretation.central_forecast_answer: Observed peer outcomes can anchor an explicit20% control. They cannot alone select Intel expected margin. Keep25% as a differentiated economics assumption, or use20% as a deliberately cautious judgment with rationale; do not describe either as statistically estimated.
margin_interpretation.removable_claim: The further rise from25% in2030 to27% by2032 is unnecessary to sustain the central operating story and lacks an independent calibration. Holding25% thereafter reduces target from82.47to82.15 at10.625%, annual return9.64%to9.54%. This is an honest simplification, not a meaningful investment-edge fix.
